title: Record investigation
purpose: Record a nonconformance's containment, root cause and whether similar cases exist or could occur.
summary: Record what was done at once to contain the problem, its root cause, and whether similar cases exist or could occur. The owner or a supervisor updates this while the record is open.

tasks.title: Record the investigation
steps: Fill in [[Containment]], [[Root cause]] and [[Similar cases]] as far as you know them.
Select [[Save investigation]]. You can come back and add more later.

tasks.title: Update what was found
steps: The form starts with what is recorded. Change the text and select [[Save investigation]].

good_to_know: Every field is optional, but saving is refused unless something changed.
Refer to an order, sample or ticket number. Do not enter patient names or identifiers.
Saving does not change the status. Use Change status on the record to move it on.
The record shows the latest text. The history notes each save without repeating the text.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Opens from Record investigation on the record, as a dialog or a full page. Only the owner or a supervisor (the admin role included) may open it; anyone else is refused. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

items.label: Containment
items.description: Optional, up to 4,000 characters. What was done at once to limit the problem. Also asked when the record is raised.

items.label: Root cause
items.description: Optional, up to 4,000 characters. Why it happened.

items.label: Similar cases
items.description: Optional, up to 4,000 characters. Whether similar nonconformities exist or could occur, and what was checked.

items.label: Save investigation
items.description: Saves and confirms Investigation saved. The history records Investigation recorded.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record without changing anything.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: Nothing changed: Change at least one detail before saving. A closed record: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it.

items.label: Stale form
items.description: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details. Your input is kept on the form.

items.label: Signed out by a time limit
items.description: When a time limit signs you out, what you typed here is kept for 24 hours, for you in that browser only, and comes back on this page when you sign in again there (a form open in a dialog opens again on its own page). It keeps the version of the record you typed against: if the record changed since, the page says This record changed after you typed it, and saving is refused with your typing on the form. Copy what you need, then select Discard on the notice, or after a refused save open the form again from the record, to see the record as it stands. It comes back even where the form is no longer offered, for example after the record was closed.
